senses.definition: to experience pain, harm, or something unpleasant
senses.example: Many families suffered during the flood.

senses.definition: a formal talk, or the act and ability of speaking
senses.example: She gave a short speech at the meeting.

senses.definition: achieving what you wanted or planned to do
senses.example: The project was successful despite the delay.

senses.definition: one of the things you can choose to do or have
senses.example: We have the option of taking the train.

senses.definition: a person who takes part in an activity or event
senses.example: Each participant received a certificate.

senses.definition: in or from the south of a place
senses.example: They live in southern China.

senses.definition: in the end, especially after a long time or many changes
senses.example: Eventually, they found their way home.

senses.definition: a place of higher education where people study for degrees
senses.example: She studies engineering at university.

senses.definition: recently made or obtained, not old, or clean and pleasant
senses.example: We bought fresh fruit at the market.

senses.definition: a large area of land covered with trees
senses.example: We walked through the forest in the morning.

senses.definition: a recording of moving images and sound
senses.example: She sent us a short video of the trip.

senses.definition: to record someone or something on video
senses.example: He videoed the children playing in the garden.

senses.zh: 全球的；全世界的；总体的
senses.definition: relating to the whole world or to the whole of something
senses.example: Climate change is a global problem.

senses.definition: the upper law-making group in some countries, or a governing group at a university
senses.example: The bill passed the Senate.

senses.definition: a change made to improve a system or law
senses.example: The government proposed tax reform.

senses.definition: to change a system or practice in order to improve it
senses.example: They plan to reform the health system.

senses.zh: 使用权；进入途径；接触机会
senses.definition: the right or way to enter, use, or reach something
senses.example: All students have access to the library.

senses.definition: to enter, use, or get information from a place or system
senses.example: You can access the files online.

senses.definition: a place where people pay to eat meals
senses.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant.

senses.definition: a person who decides cases in court or chooses a winner
senses.example: The judge listened to both sides.

senses.definition: to form an opinion about someone or something, or decide a case in court
senses.example: Do not judge a person by one mistake.

senses.definition: to make a book, article, or information available to the public
senses.example: The journal published her research.

senses.definition: a connection between people or things, or a person in your family
senses.example: There is a clear relation between sleep and health.

senses.definition: to let someone go free or make something available to the public
senses.example: The company will release the report tomorrow.

senses.definition: the act of setting someone free or making something available
senses.example: The film's release was delayed.

senses.definition: an animal with wings, feathers, and a beak
senses.example: A small bird landed on the window.

senses.definition: work, especially physical work; workers as a group; or the process of giving birth
senses.example: The job requires a lot of physical labor.
senses.note: labor 是美式拼写；英式常写 labour。

senses.definition: to work hard, often for a long time
senses.example: They labored all day to finish the road.

senses.definition: what someone thinks or believes about a subject
senses.example: In my opinion, the plan is too expensive.

senses.definition: trust that you will pay later, praise for work done, or a unit earned in a course
senses.example: She deserves credit for solving the problem.

senses.definition: to say someone is responsible for something good or add money to an account
senses.example: The refund was credited to my account.

senses.definition: very important, showing judgment of faults, or very serious
senses.example: Early treatment is critical to recovery.

senses.definition: the place where two sides or streets meet
senses.example: There is a bookshop on the corner.

senses.definition: to force someone into a place they cannot escape or gain control of a market
senses.example: The reporters cornered him after the meeting.

senses.definition: worried about something, caring about it, or involved in it
senses.example: Her parents were concerned about her health.

senses.definition: to remember something or ask for a product to be returned
senses.example: I cannot recall where I left my keys.

senses.definition: the ability to remember or an order to return a product
senses.example: The company announced a recall of the toy.

senses.definition: a particular form of something or a person's account of an event
senses.example: This is the latest version of the app.

senses.definition: to look at someone or something for a long time
senses.example: He stared at the screen in surprise.

senses.definition: a long fixed look at someone or something
senses.example: She gave him a cold stare.

senses.definition: the state of being safe from danger or harm
senses.example: The safety of the children comes first.

senses.definition: producing the result that is wanted
senses.example: This medicine is effective against the infection.

senses.definition: the area near where someone lives or a particular place
senses.example: There is a park in our neighborhood.
senses.note: 美式写 neighborhood，英式写 neighbourhood。

senses.definition: existing from the beginning or made in a new and unusual way
senses.example: The original plan was to leave on Friday.

senses.definition: the first form of a document or work, not a copy
senses.example: Please keep the original and send us a copy.

senses.definition: soldiers as a group, or a group of people or animals
senses.example: More troops were sent to the area.
senses.note: 指军人时常用复数 troops。

senses.definition: to walk somewhere together in a group
senses.example: The children trooped into the hall.

senses.definition: money received from work, business, or investments
senses.example: Her income rose last year.

senses.definition: without another person or step in between, or by the shortest way
senses.example: Please contact me directly if you have questions.

senses.definition: to cause physical pain or harm, or make someone feel sad
senses.example: I hurt my knee while running.

senses.definition: injured or upset by what someone has done
senses.example: She felt hurt by his words.

senses.definition: physical or emotional pain
senses.example: Time helped ease the hurt.

senses.definition: a group of living things that are similar and can produce young together
senses.example: This species of bird lives near water.
senses.note: species 的单数与复数同形。

senses.definition: at once, without waiting
senses.example: Call me immediately if anything changes.

senses.definition: a path, a set of rails, a mark left by movement, or a running course
senses.example: We followed the track through the woods.

senses.definition: to follow the movement or progress of someone or something
senses.example: The app tracks how many steps you take.

senses.definition: simple and necessary, or forming the base of something
senses.example: First learn the basic rules.

senses.zh: 女士（不表明婚姻状况的称谓）
senses.definition: a title used before a woman's name without saying whether she is married
senses.example: Ms Chen will lead the meeting.
senses.note: 通常写在姓或全名前，不用于单独称呼。

senses.definition: to hit something, stop work in protest, or happen suddenly
senses.example: Lightning struck the tree last night.

senses.definition: a period when workers stop work, or an attack or hit
senses.example: The train strike lasted two days.

senses.definition: the space above the earth that you see when you look up
senses.example: The sky turned pink at sunset.

senses.definition: the right or ability to do what you choose without unfair control
senses.example: Everyone should have freedom of speech.

senses.definition: completely, or used to strongly agree with someone
senses.example: I absolutely agree with you.

senses.definition: a vehicle with wings that flies, a flat surface, or a tool used to smooth wood
senses.example: Our plane leaves at nine tomorrow.
senses.note: 日常最常见的是“飞机”；数学中的 plane 是“平面”。

senses.definition: to make wood smooth with a plane
senses.example: He planed the door to make it fit.

senses.definition: not any person
senses.example: Nobody knew the answer.

senses.definition: a person who is not well known or important
senses.example: He felt like a nobody in the big city.

senses.definition: to succeed in doing or getting something after effort
senses.example: She worked hard to achieve her goal.

senses.definition: a thing you can see or touch, or something you aim to achieve
senses.example: The object on the shelf is made of wood.
senses.note: 名词重音通常在第一个音节。

senses.definition: to say that you do not agree with something
senses.example: Several neighbors objected to the plan.
senses.note: 动词重音通常在第二个音节，常接 to。

senses.definition: the number 9
senses.example: The class starts at nine o'clock.

senses.definition: the way you think and feel about someone or something
senses.example: She has a positive attitude toward learning.

senses.definition: to mention something, mean something, or send a person to someone for help
senses.example: The report refers to a recent study.

senses.definition: a person or company that pays for a professional service
senses.example: The lawyer met her client this morning.

senses.definition: an idea about what something is or how it works
senses.example: It took time to understand the concept.

senses.zh: 强大的；有影响力的；有力的
senses.definition: having great strength, control, or influence
senses.example: The speech made a powerful impression.

senses.definition: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose
senses.example: This is the perfect place for a picnic.

senses.definition: to improve something until it is as good as possible
senses.example: She spent years perfecting her technique.
senses.note: 动词通常重读第二音节。

senses.definition: for that reason; as a result
senses.example: It was raining; therefore, we stayed home.

senses.definition: to organize and carry out an activity, or lead musicians
senses.example: The team conducted a survey of parents.
senses.note: 动词通常重读第二音节。

senses.definition: the way a person behaves, especially in public or at work
senses.example: The school has rules about student conduct.
senses.note: 名词通常重读第一音节。

senses.definition: to tell people something officially or publicly
senses.example: They announced the result on Monday.

senses.definition: a talk between two or more people
senses.example: We had a long conversation about the book.

senses.zh: 检查；审查；仔细研究；考核
senses.definition: to look at someone or something carefully, or test a person's knowledge
senses.example: The doctor examined her knee.

senses.definition: to put your hand on something, make contact, or affect someone's feelings
senses.example: Please do not touch the painting.

senses.definition: the act or feeling of touching something
senses.example: The fabric felt soft to the touch.

senses.definition: used to make a request more polite
senses.example: Please close the door quietly.
senses.note: 表示礼貌请求；有些词典将此用法列作感叹词。

senses.definition: to make someone happy or satisfied
senses.example: Her answer pleased the teacher.

senses.definition: to go to an event or place, or take care of someone or something
senses.example: Over fifty people attended the meeting.
senses.note: attend to 表示照料或处理，和 attend a meeting 的结构不同。

senses.definition: in every way or in every part
senses.example: I completely forgot about the appointment.

senses.definition: many different kinds of things, or one particular kind
senses.example: The shop sells a variety of fresh bread.

senses.definition: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind less active
senses.example: I could not sleep because of the noise.

senses.definition: the natural period of rest when you are asleep
senses.example: Children need enough sleep each night.

senses.definition: taking part in something, connected with it, or difficult to understand
senses.example: Both parents are involved in the school project.
senses.note: 日常 be/get involved in 常指参与；复杂难懂是另一义项。

senses.definition: a careful search for facts about an event or problem
senses.example: The police opened an investigation into the fire.

senses.definition: relating to the center of an atom, energy from it, or weapons using it
senses.example: The country built a new nuclear power plant.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to study a subject carefully to discover facts
senses.example: Researchers are testing a new treatment.

senses.definition: to push firmly on something or strongly urge someone to act
senses.example: Press the button to start the machine.

senses.definition: newspapers and news organizations, or the act of pushing something
senses.example: The news was reported in the press.

senses.definition: a serious disagreement or fight between people, groups, or ideas
senses.example: The two reports are in conflict.
senses.note: 名词通常重读第一音节。

senses.definition: to be different in a way that prevents two things from being true or possible together
senses.example: The accounts conflict with each other.
senses.note: 动词通常重读第二音节。

senses.definition: a person's mood or courage, the part thought to live beyond the body, or a strong alcoholic drink
senses.example: The team showed great spirit after the loss.

senses.definition: to put something new in place of something else or return it to its place
senses.example: We need to replace the broken window.

senses.definition: relating to the United Kingdom or its people
senses.example: She prefers British English spelling.

senses.definition: the people of the United Kingdom considered as a group
senses.example: The British voted in the election.
senses.note: the British 作集合名词；单个人通常说 a British person。

senses.definition: to give someone confidence or make an action more likely
senses.example: Her teacher encouraged her to keep reading.

senses.definition: an angry disagreement or a reason given to support an idea
senses.example: They had an argument about money.

senses.definition: a place where people stay in tents, a trip there, or a group sharing views
senses.example: The children stayed at a summer camp.

senses.definition: to stay outside in a tent for a short time
senses.example: We camped beside the lake.

senses.definition: the organ inside the head used for thought and body control
senses.example: Sleep helps the brain work well.

senses.definition: an important quality or part of something, or a special article
senses.example: The phone has a useful safety feature.
senses.note: features 也可指面部特征；单数日常首先是特点或功能。

senses.definition: to include or show someone or something as an important part
senses.example: The show features local musicians.

senses.definition: the part of the day between noon and evening
senses.example: We will meet on Tuesday afternoon.

senses.zh: 是（be 的第一人称现在式）
senses.definition: the form of be used with I in the present tense
senses.example: I am ready to leave.
senses.note: 不要与 a.m.（上午）混淆。

senses.definition: Saturday and Sunday, when many people do not work
senses.example: We visited our grandparents last weekend.

senses.definition: a group of twelve things
senses.example: She bought a dozen eggs.

senses.definition: the chance that something may happen, or one thing that may happen
senses.example: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.

senses.definition: an agreement to pay money if something bad happens, or the business providing it
senses.example: Do you have travel insurance?

senses.definition: one part of a company, government, hospital, or university
senses.example: She works in the sales department.

senses.definition: a fight between armies or a long effort to win or solve something
senses.example: The battle lasted for three days.

senses.definition: to fight against someone or work hard against a problem
senses.example: She battled illness for many years.

senses.definition: the first part of something
senses.example: The beginning of the book is exciting.

senses.definition: a day on a calendar, a planned romantic meeting, or a sweet brown fruit
senses.example: Please write the date at the top of the page.

senses.definition: to have romantic meetings, put a date on something, or find when it was made
senses.example: They dated for two years before they married.

senses.definition: usually or in most cases, without considering every detail
senses.example: I generally walk to work.

senses.definition: relating to Africa or its people
senses.example: She studies African history.

senses.definition: a person from Africa
senses.example: Many Africans speak more than one language.

senses.definition: feeling regret for something you did or sad about something that happened
senses.example: I'm sorry I was late.

senses.definition: a time of great difficulty or danger when important decisions are needed
senses.example: The company faced a financial crisis.
senses.note: 复数是 crises。

senses.definition: having all parts or being finished
senses.example: The list is now complete.

senses.definition: to finish an activity or fill in every required part
senses.example: Please complete the form before Friday.

senses.definition: a machine or object that moves air, or someone who greatly likes something
senses.example: She is a big fan of the team.

senses.definition: to move air with a fan or make a feeling stronger
senses.example: She fanned the fire to keep it burning.

senses.definition: to attach firmly, become unable to move, or continue doing something
senses.example: Stick the label on the box.
senses.note: 过去式和过去分词均为 stuck。

senses.definition: a long, thin piece of wood or a similar object
senses.example: He picked up a stick from the ground.
